model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 GGUF (abenzerps) Q6_K 7B
model.description: GGUF Q6_K quantization of the original Qwen Image 2.1 base weights by abenzerps. The publisher renamed the repository and says a separate uncensored variant is still in development. Uses the shared 2.1 VAE and Qwen3-VL encoder.
model.selector_help: Third-party quantization of the original base model, formerly labelled Uncensored. No separate uncensoring modification is documented for these weights. Same creation and editing tools as Qwen Image 2.1.

resource_requirements.note: Original base weights in GGUF. Legacy model ID retained for saved recipes; not a verified uncensored fine-tune.
